name: December 8, 2025 - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu City Council
  Regular Meeting

Please take notice that the Regular City Council Meeting of Monday, December 8,
2025 is hereby adjourned to Wednesday, December 17, 2025 at 3:30 p.m.

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City Hall,
23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the City Clerk’s
Office at cityclerk@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 296.

Dated: December 9, 2025 at 1:00 a.m.

__________________________________

Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk
